question: Can a frozen eight-hypothesis predictor fail closed when none of its eight candidates can explain four calibration transitions, rather than force an inaccurate model?
hypothesis: An exact zero-error hypothesis acceptance gate will accept in-class a=2 but reject out-of-class a=3, while the forced-nearest in-class model will make inaccurate predictions on out-of-class cases.
family: Candidate hypotheses x[t]=(x[t-1]+a*x[t-2]+b)%4, a∈{1,2}, b∈{0,1,2,3}, fixed to eight. In-class new seeds 88,90,92,94 have true a=2; out-of-class new seeds 89,91,93,95 true a=3. All have b=(seed-88)%4. The seed value and true coefficients are generator-only, not predictor inputs.
generator: Each of 16 episodes initializes x0=(e+seed)%4,x1=(floor(e/4)+3*seed)%4; generate 32 positions. Calibration observes t2 labels only for episodes0..3 (four distinct x0 contexts); test holds episodes4..15 at positions2..31 (360 per seed).
arms: gate: accept only if exactly one of eight candidates has four zero calibration mismatches; otherwise abstain on all 360 test predictions, with no test label used to make the decision
forced_best: choose one candidate from eight minimizing four calibration mismatches with fixed lexicographic tie break, always predict even on out-of-class input
primary: Record candidate mismatch count, accepted/rejected per seed, true in-/out-class detection, coverage across 2880 total test slots, accepted-only prediction accuracy, and forced control accuracy separately for in-/out-class. OPEN_SET_REJECTION if all four in-class accepted with 100% correct, all four out-of-class rejected, and no wrong actionable predictions; FALSE_ACCEPT if any out-class accepted; FALSE_REJECT if any in-class rejected; NEGATIVE otherwise.
safeguards: The evaluator may report generator true a only after decision; policy sees calibration triples only. No candidate expansion, dynamic thresholds, heldout feedback, adaptive retry or accepted-ref write. Fixture-only synthetic triples preflight (not any real experimental seed), source Git blobs frozen before first original, archive and full repository regression.
claim_limit: Finite calibrated open-set rejection for deliberately excluded modular dynamics, not general OOD or real-world scientific validity.
